question: How many customers do we have in each segment?
gold_sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY segment

question: How many products are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products GROUP BY category

question: How many orders were placed through each channel?
gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY channel

question: What is the total revenue for 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: How many orders were returned?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM orders WHERE status='returned'

question: What is the total revenue by region?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY r.name

question: What is the total revenue by product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show total revenue for each month of 2025
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: What is the number of units sold per category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

question: How many completed orders did each region have?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY r.name

question: What is the revenue by sales channel?
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.channel

question: What is the return rate for each channel?
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),4) AS return_rate FROM orders GROUP BY channel

question: What was the revenue of the South region in Q3 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND r.name='South' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'

question: What is the average order value for each customer segment?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount))/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.segment

question: What was total revenue in each quarter of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) <= 3 THEN 'Q1' WHEN CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 'Q2' WHEN CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) <= 9 THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY quarter

question: Compare Electronics revenue in the South region between Q2 and Q3 2025
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-06-30' THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q3' END AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND r.name='South' AND p.category='Electronics' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-09-30' GROUP BY quarter

question: Who are the top 3 customers by revenue? Show their names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the revenue by customer segment in the South region in Q3 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)),2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND r.name='South' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' GROUP BY c.segment

question: What is the average discount given in each product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(AVG(oi.discount),4) AS avg_discount FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category
